reviews.title: Great board!
reviews.comment: Easy install and works like a charm, no issues with secure boot either!
reviews.author: Jbov1

reviews.title: I LOVE IT
reviews.comment: Best motherboard I ever had! Super clean and working best!🫶 So many connection on the board and easy installation.
reviews.author: Michael Babych

reviews.title: Good quality motherboard
reviews.comment: Good solid build. Easy to work with. A lot of good QoS in the design. Honestly a great board that considers the users. My only complaint is in the BIOS, first time working with Gigabyte specifically Aorus motherboard so the BIOS was difficult to navigate, but that is not gigabyte's fault and more my own.
reviews.author: Elizabeth

reviews.title: Great motherboard even with minor issues.
reviews.comment: Works great. Once you get driver's installed it connects perfectly. My only issue was slight damage to the io sheld (outer package not damaged) which didn't effect the performance, and I had a false VGA error light which was cleared with a reset with a restart and again does affect performance. It looks great, fits pretty well and speeds have been perfect.
reviews.author: Rose Lessard

reviews.title: I don't regret my purchase.
reviews.comment: Excellent board, performs much better than my old B650. Would recommend if you have an X3D like my 9850X3D.
reviews.author: Thomas Warner
